an8.19:2.3: ‘Kati pana Pahārāda mahāsamudde acchariyā abbhutā dhammā, ye disvā disvā asurā mahāsamudde abhiramantī' ti?
an8.19:2.4: Aṭṭha bhante mahāsamudde acchariyā abbhutā dhammā, ye disvā disvā asurā mahāsamudde abhiramanti.
an8.19:2.6: Mahāsamuddo bhante anupubbaninno anupubbapoṇo anupubbapabbhāro na āyataken' eva papāto.
an8.19:2.7: Yam pi bhante mahāsamuddo anupubbaninno anupubbapoṇo anupubbapabbhāro na āyataken' eva papāto:
an8.19:2.8: ayaṃ bhante mahāsamudde paṭhamo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo, yaṃ disvā disvā asurā mahāsamudde abhiramanti. 3.
an8.19:3.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhante mahāsamuddo ṭhitadhammo velaṃ nātivattati.
an8.19:3.2: Yam pi bhante mahāsamuddo ṭhitadhammo velaṃ nātivattati:
an8.19:3.3: ayaṃ bhante mahāsamudde dutiyo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo, yaṃ disvā disvā asurā mahāsamudde abhiramanti. 4.
an8.19:4.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhante mahāsamuddo na matena kuṇapena saṃvasati; yaṃ hoti mahāsamudde mataṃ kuṇapaṃ, taṃ khippaṃ eva tīraṃ vāheti thalaṃ ussādeti.
an8.19:4.2: Yam pi bhante mahāsamuddo na matena kuṇapena saṃvasati; yaṃ hoti mahāsamudde mataṃ kuṇapaṃ, taṃ khippam eva tīraṃ vāheti thalaṃ ussādeti:
an8.19:4.3: ayaṃ bhante mahāsamudde tatiyo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo, yaṃ disvā disvā asurā mahāsamudde abhiramanti. 5.
an8.19:5.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhante yā kāci mahānadiyo, seyyathīdaṃ
an8.19:5.2: Gaṅgā Yamunā Aciravatī Sarabhū Mahī, tā mahāsamuddaṃ patvā jahanti purimāni nāmagottāni, mahāsamuddo tveva saṃkhaṃ gacchanti.
an8.19:5.3: Yam pi bhante yā kāci mahānadiyo, seyyathīdaṃ Gaṅgā Yamunā Aciravatī Sarabhū Mahī, tā mahāsamuddaṃ patvā jahanti purimāni nāmagottāni, mahāsamuddo tveva saṃkhaṃ gacchanti:
an8.19:5.4: ayaṃ bhante mahāsamudde catuttho acchariyo abbhuto dhammo, yaṃ disvā disvā asurā mahāsamudde abhiramanti. 6.
an8.19:6.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhante yā kāci loke savantiyo mahāsamuddaṃ appenti, yā kāci antalikkhā dhārā papatanti, na tena mahāsamuddassa ūnattaṃ vā pūrattaṃ vā paññāyati.
an8.19:6.2: Yam pi bhante yā kāci loke savantiyo mahāsamuddaṃ appenti, yā kāci antalikkhā dhārā papatanti, na tena mahāsamuddassa ūnattaṃ vā pūrattaṃ vā paññāyati:
an8.19:6.3: ayaṃ bhante mahāsamudde pañcamo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo, yaṃ disvā disvā asurā mahāsamudde abhiramanti. 7.
an8.19:7.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhante mahāsamuddo ekaraso loṇaraso.
an8.19:7.2: Yam pi bhante mahāsamuddo ekaraso loṇaraso:
an8.19:7.3: ayaṃ bhante mahāsamudde chaṭṭho acchariyo abbhuto dhammo, yaṃ disvā disvā asurā mahāsamudde abhiramanti. 8.
an8.19:8.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhante mahāsamuddo bahuratano anekaratano, tatr' imāni ratanāni, seyyathīdaṃ muttā maṇi veḷuriyo saṅkho silā pavāḷaṃ rajataṃ jātarūpaṃ lohitaṅko masāragallaṃ.
an8.19:8.2: Yam pi bhante mahāsamuddo bahuratano anekaratano, tatr' imāni ratanāni, seyyathīdaṃ muttā maṇi veḷuriyo saṅkho silā pavāḷaṃ rajataṃ jātarūpaṃ lohitaṅko masāragallaṃ:
an8.19:8.3: ayaṃ bhante mahāsamudde sattamo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo, yaṃ disvā disvā asurā mahāsamudde abhiramanti. 9.
an8.19:9.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhante mahāsamuddo mahataṃ bhūtānaṃ āvāso, tatr' ime bhūtā timitimiṅgalā timiramiṅgalā asurā nāgā gandhabbā; santi mahāsamudde yojanasatikā pi attabhāvā dviyojanasatikā pi attabhāvā tiyojanasatikā pi attabhāvā catuyojanasatikā pi attabhāvā pañcayojanasatikā pi attabhāvā.
an8.19:9.2: Yam pi bhante mahāsamuddo mahataṃ bhūtānaṃ āvāso, tatr' ime bhūtā timitimiṅgalā timiramiṅgalā asurā nāgā gandhabbā; santi mahāsamudde yojanasatikā pi attabhāvā dviyojanasatikā pi attabhāvā tiyojanasatikā pi attabhāvā catuyojanasatikā pi attabhāvā pañcayojanasatikā pi attabhāvā:
an8.19:9.3: ayaṃ bhante mahāsamudde aṭṭhamo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo, yaṃ disvā disvā asurā mahāsamudde abhiramanti.
an8.19:9.4: Ime kho bhante mahāsamudde aṭṭha acchariyā abbhutā dhammā, ye disvā disvā asurā mahāsamudde abhiramanti;
an8.19:10.1: api pana bhante bhikkhū imasmiṃ dhammavinaye abhiramantī ti?
an8.19:10.3: Kati pana bhante imasmiṃ dhammavinaye acchariyā abbhutā dhammā, ye disvā disvā bhikkhū imasmiṃ dhammavinaye abhiramantī ti? 10.
an8.19:10.4: ‘Aṭṭha Pahārāda imasmiṃ dhammavinaye acchariyā abbhutā dhammā, ye disvā disvā bhikkhū imasmiṃ dhammavinaye abhiramanti.
an8.19:10.6: Seyyathā pi Pahārādā mahāsamuddo anupubbaninno anupubbapoṇo anupubbapabbhāro na āyataken' eva papāto,
an8.19:10.7: evam eva kho Pahārāda imasmiṃ dhammavinaye anupubbasikkhā anupubbakiriyā anupubbapaṭipadā na āyataken' eva aññāpaṭivedho.
an8.19:10.8: Yam pi Pahārāda imasmiṃ dhammavinaye anupubbasikkhā anupubbakiriyā anupubbapaṭipadā na āyataken' eva aññāpaṭivedho:
an8.19:10.9: ayaṃ Pahārāda imasmiṃ dhammavinaye paṭhamo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo, yaṃ disvā disvā bhikkhū imasmiṃ dhammavinaye abhiramanti. 12.
an8.19:11.1: Seyyathā pi Pahārāda mahāsamuddo ṭhitadhammo velaṃ nātivattati,
an8.19:11.2: evam eva kho Pahārāda yaṃ mayā sāvakānaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ, taṃ mama sāvakā jīvitahetu pi nātikkamanti.
an8.19:11.3: Yam pi Pahārāda mayā sāvakānaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ, taṃ mama sāvakā jīvitahetu pi nātikkamanti:
an8.19:11.4: ayaṃ Pahārāda imasmiṃ dhammavinaye dutiyo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo, yaṃ disvā disvā bhikkhū imasmiṃ dhammavinaye abhiramanti. 13.
an8.19:12.1: Seyyathā pi Pahārāda mahāsamuddo na matena kuṇapena saṃvasati; yaṃ hoti mahāsamudde mataṃ kuṇapaṃ, taṃ khippam eva tīraṃ vāheti thalaṃ ussādeti: evam
an8.19:13.1: eva kho Pahārāda yo so puggalo dussīlo pāpadhammo asucisaṃkassarasamācāro paṭicchannakammanto assamaṇo samaṇapaṭiñño abrahmacārī brahmacārīpaṭiñño antopūti avassuto kasambujāto, na tena saṅgho saṃvasati, khippam eva naṃ sannipatitvā ukkhipati; kiñcāpi so hoti majjhe bhikkhusaṅghassa nisinno, atha kho so ārakā 'va saṅghamhā saṅgho ca tena.
an8.19:13.2: Yam pi Pahārāda yo so puggalo dussīlo pāpadhammo asucisaṃkassarasamācāro paṭicchannakammanto assamaṇo samaṇapaṭiñño abrahmacārī brahmacārīpaṭiñño antopūti avassuto kasambujāto, na tena saṅgho saṃvasati, khippaṃ eva naṃ sannipatitvā ukkhipati; kiñcāpi so hoti majjhe bhikkhusaṅghassa nisinno, atha kho so ārakā 'va saṅghamhā saṅgho ca tena:
an8.19:13.3: ayaṃ Pahārāda imasmiṃ dhammavinaye tatiyo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo, yaṃ disvā disvā bhikkhū imasmiṃ dhammavinaye abhiramanti. 14.
an8.19:14.1: Seyyathā pi Pahārāda yā kāci mahānadiyo, seyyathīdaṃ Gaṅgā Yamunā Aciravatī Sarabhū Mahī, tā mahāsamuddaṃ patvā jahanti purimāni nāmagottāni, mahāsamuddo tveva saṃkhaṃ gacchanti:
an8.19:14.2: evam eva kho Pahārāda cattāro 'me vaṇṇā: khattiyā brāhmaṇā vessā suddā, te Tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitvā jahanti purimāni nāmagottāni, samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā tveva saṃkhaṃ gacchanti.
an8.19:14.3: Yam pi Pahārāda cattāro 'me vaṇṇā: khattiyā brāhmaṇā vessā suddā, te Tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitvā jahanti purimāni nāmagottāni, samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā tveva saṃkhaṃ gacchanti:
an8.19:14.4: ayam Pahārāda imasmiṃ dhammavinaye catuttho acchariyo abbhuto dhammo, yaṃ disvā disvā bhikkhū imasmiṃ dhammavinaye abhiramanti. 15.
an8.19:15.1: Seyyathā pi Pahārāda yā kāci loke savantiyo mahāsamuddaṃ appeni, yā kāci antalikkhā dhārā papatanti, na tena mahāsamuddassa ūnattaṃ vā pūrattaṃ vā paññāyati:
an8.19:15.2: evam eva kho Pahārāda bahū ce pi bhikkhū anupādisesāya nibbānadhātuyā parinibbāyanti, na tena nibbānadhātuyā ūnattaṃ vā pūrattaṃ vā paññāyati.
an8.19:15.3: Yam pi Pahārāda bahū ce pi bhikkhū anupādisesāya nibbānadhātuyā parinibbāyanti, na tena nibbānadhātuyā ūnattaṃ vā pūrattaṃ vā paññāyati:
an8.19:15.4: ayaṃ Pahārāda imasmiṃ dhammavinaye pañcamo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo, yaṃ disvā disvā bhikkhū imasmiṃ dhammavinaye abhiramanti. 16.
an8.19:16.1: Seyyathā pi Pahārāda mahāsamuddo ekaraso loṇaraso,
an8.19:16.2: evam eva kho Pahārāda ayaṃ dhammavinayo ekaraso vimuttiraso.
an8.19:16.3: Yam pi Pahārāda ayaṃ dhammavinayo ekaraso vimuttiraso:
an8.19:16.4: ayaṃ Pahārāda imasmiṃ dhammavinaye chaṭṭho acchariyo abbhuto dhammo, yaṃ disvā disvā bhikkhū imasmiṃ dhammavinaye abhiramanti. 17.
an8.19:17.1: Seyyathā pi Pahārāda mahāsamuddo bahuratano anekaratano, tatr' imāni ratanāni, seyyathīdaṃ muttā maṇi veḷuriyo saṅkho silā pavāḷaṃ rajataṃ jātarūpaṃ lohitaṅko masāragallaṃ:
an8.19:17.2: evam eva kho Pahārāda ayaṃ dhammavinayo bahuratano anekaratano, tatr' imāni ratanāni, seyyathīdaṃ cattāro satipaṭṭhānā, cattāro sammappadhānā, cattāro iddhipādā, pañc' indriyāni, pañca balāni, satta bojjhaṅgā, ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo.
an8.19:17.3: Yam pi Pahārāda ayaṃ dhammavinayo bahuratano anekaratano, tatr' imāni ratanāni, seyyathīdaṃ cattāro satipaṭṭhānā, cattāro sammappadhānā, cattāro iddhipādā, pañc' indriyāni, pañca balāni, satta bojjhaṅgā, ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo:
an8.19:17.4: ayaṃ Pahārāda imasmiṃ dhammavinaye sattamo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo, yaṃ disvā disvā bhikkhū imasmiṃ dhammavinaye abhiramanti. 18.
an8.19:18.1: Seyyathā pi Pahārāda mahāsamuddo mahataṃ bhūtānaṃ āvāso, tatr' ime bhūtā: timitimiṅgalā timiramiṅgalā asurā nāgā gandhabbā; santi mahāsamudde yojanasatikā pi attabhāvā dviyojanasatikā pi attabhāvā tiyojanasatikā pi attabhāvā catuyojanasatikā pi attabhāvā pañcayojanasatikā pi attabhāvā:
an8.19:18.2: evam eva kho Pahārāda ayaṃ dhammavinayo mahataṃ bhūtānaṃ āvāso, tatr' ime bhūtā: sotāpanno sotāpattiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno, sakadāgāmī sakadāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno, anāgāmī anāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno, arahā arahattāya paṭipanno.
an8.19:18.3: Yam pi Pahārāda ayaṃ dhammavinayo mahataṃ bhūtānaṃ āvāso, tatr' ime bhūtā: sotāpanno sotāpattiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno, sakadāgāmī sakadāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno, anāgāmī anāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno, arahā arahattāya paṭipanno:
an8.19:18.4: ayaṃ Pahārāda imasmiṃ dhammavinaye aṭṭhamo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo, yaṃ disvā disvā bhikkhū imasmiṃ dhammavinaye abhiramanti.
an8.19:19.1: Ime kho Pahārāda imasmiṃ dhammavinaye aṭṭha acchariyā abbhutā dhammā, ye disvā disvā bhikkhū imasmiṃ dhammavinaye abhiramantī' ti. 1. Evam
